name: SMS Electric Co.,Ltd.Zhengzhou
summary: SMS Electric Co.,Ltd.Zhengzhou, established in 1996 and headquartered in Zhengzhou, China, is an enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and sale of electrical measurement and management solutions. Its core offerings in China encompass electricity metering instruments, power transformers, and acquisition terminals for managing electricity loads. The company's comprehensive product range further extends to standard testing devices, portable meter test systems, energy meter terminals, automated testing solutions, and simulation equipment. Beyond its domestic operations, SMS Electric actively exports its products globally, reaching markets such as South Korea, Australia, Mongolia, Denmark, India, Pakistan, Vietnam, and Bangladesh.
